author: Toll, Ian W.
title: Pacific Crucible: War at Sea in the Pacific, 1941–1942
publisher: W. W. Norton & Company, New York
notes: First of the Pacific War trilogy: Pearl Harbor to Midway, with a long opening on the Japanese naval establishment and its politics that is unusually good on why the war was begun. Toll is the readable modern narrative the arc will lean on for continuity, and he incorporates the post-1990s revisions — source:parshall-tully-2005 among them — that Morison predates. He is a synthesis, not an archive study: for a strength, a time or a position, prefer the official histories and cite Toll for the connective account. Verified against catalogue records only; no ISBN is recorded, and the 2012 date some catalogues give is the paperback.
